fusions.name: Portcullis Drop
fusions.desc: Drops a grate round you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 0.8 seconds and leaving them [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Door Swung To
fusions.desc: A closing blow that deals 22 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Pinned] for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Turnkey's Hour
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Behind the Bars
fusions.desc: Your armour is 10% higher against enemies carrying your afflictions.
